nutrition.title: MAXIME GAUDET — NUTRITION BLOCK 2
nutrition.desc: Complete nutrition structure with two distinct options: PLAN 1 — CLASSIC and PLAN 2 — VARIETY. Training days are nutrition recommendations only: Monday, Wednesday, Friday. Tuesday, Thursday and Saturday are rest/work or active recovery. Sunday is batch cooking plus one controlled free meal option.

rules.title: Training-day targets
rules.detail: Training days: 2550 cal. Rest/work days: 2400 cal. Protein: 190 g/day. Water: 3 L+/day.

rules.title: Protein first
rules.detail: Protein comes first at every meal. Aim for the listed protein target before adjusting carbs or fats.

rules.title: One free meal per week
rules.detail: One free meal per week, Saturday or Sunday, not both. Aim for 40 g+ protein and stay controlled.

rules.title: Lactose-free protein
rules.detail: Use lactose-free protein. Plan 1 specifically requires lactose-free protein. Avoid unplanned dairy.

rules.title: Supplements
rules.detail: Daily: greens, multi, omega-3, D3 and magnesium.

rules.title: Creatine
rules.detail: Creatine is suspended during the active riding period.

rules.title: Tracking
rules.detail: First 30 days: weigh and log food.

rules.title: No recalculation
rules.detail: Calories and macros are transcribed from the coach plan as written. Some daily totals are approximate when the source says approximately.

nutrition.futureNote: Choose either PLAN 1 — CLASSIC or PLAN 2 — VARIETY for the week; do not merge both plans on the same day unless Coach Max tells you to.

summary.name: Nutrition overview
summary.detail: Two complete options are available. PLAN 1 — CLASSIC is the tighter classic structure. PLAN 2 — VARIETY adds alternate breakfasts, wraps, smoothies and more variety while keeping the same training/rest targets.

summary.name: Common calorie and protein targets
summary.detail: Training days: 2550 cal. Rest/work days: 2400 cal. Protein: 190 g/day. Water: 3 L+/day. Monday, Wednesday and Friday are training-day recommendations; Tuesday, Thursday and Saturday are rest/work or active recovery recommendations.

rows.name: PLAN 1 — CLASSIC

rows.name: Sunday batch 1 — Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday prep
rows.detail: Cook in parallel. Chicken cubes: 1.5 kg chicken breast, cubes, olive oil, salt, pepper, garlic powder, oven 400 °F, 20-22 min, divide into 3 containers of 200 g. White rice: 600 g dry rice, yields about 1.8 kg cooked, divide into 3 portions of 200 g cooked. Roasted vegetables: broccoli, peppers, zucchini, olive oil, salt, divide into 3 portions. Hard-boiled eggs: 12 eggs, 10 min in boiling water. Sweet potatoes: 3 sweet potatoes, cubes, oven 400 °F, 25 min, divide into 3 portions.
